text: Open with the problem and the discipline, not the products. This is a private consulting proposal for jointly developing the curriculum, reference implementation, and release program.

name: premise-main
text:
A learned policy is not yet
a physical system.

name: premise-body
text: The difficult work begins when inference receives authority over a body, acts into a changing world, and must live with what happens next.
textPreview: The difficult work begins when inference receives authority over a body, acts into a changing world, and must live with what happens next.

text: The curriculum starts from a constraint. Closed-loop systems pay costs that decoupled AI can ignore. Let this statement land before introducing the proposed discipline.

text: This two-axis framing keeps governance intellectually honest. Feedback concerns dynamics. Delegation concerns authority. The capstone requires evidence on both.

text: These verbs are the curriculum spine and the evaluation language. They also give partners a durable vocabulary that survives any single board or robot generation.

name: source-11
text: Teaching implementation. No benchmark result is asserted; veto latency is measured in the lab.
textPreview: Teaching implementation. No benchmark result is asserted; veto latency is measured in the lab.

text: Walk left to right. The MPU proposes intent. The MCU disposes within an action contract. A bad proposal becomes a visible veto. The lab measures Bridge receipt to bounded output and uses the measured tail to defend placement.
